name: Sethik Coilhand
languages: Common plus one other language, Draconic

abilities.name: Blood-Rung Toll
abilities.description: While Sethik has half of its hit points or fewer, when a creature fails its save against Sethik's Unarmed Strike, it is also deafened and has disadvantage on its next attack roll.

abilities.name: Hold Breath
abilities.description: Sethik can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

abilities.name: Marsh Stride
abilities.description: Difficult Terrain composed of mud doesn't cost Sethik extra movement, and Sethik can move across mud without needing to make an ability check.

abilities.name: Cunning Action (Bonus Action)
abilities.description: Sethik takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Sethik makes two attacks: one with Unarmed Strike and one with Dart.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (4d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage. Once on each of Sethik's turns when it hits with this attack, the target is subjected to the following effect. The target must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target is stunned until the end of Sethik's next turn.

actions.name: Dart
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage.

other_edition.languages: Common plus one other language, Draconic
